anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, smooth convex arc forming a rounded forehead profile with a large curvature radius.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Minimal horizontal extension; the rostrum is blunt and tapers steeply, with length nearly equal to its vertical thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Indistinct inflection; the melon transitions into the rostrum via a continuous, obtuse curve lacking a defined notch or angle.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark pigmentation localized around the ocular region forming a distinct eye patch; high-intensity light saturation/overexposure in the mid-lateral zone.
